note: ring 0 alone is swept open loop while the other rings hold their warm-start codes: 2 ms at the lowest code, a linear ramp up, 2 ms at the top, a linear ramp down (40 ms each). Only line 0 is on (lines_on), so the loop is the ring's own self-heating; the light at the ring is set by the chip input loss (10, 6, 2 dB: the model's 0 to +8 dBm world range); the last entry repeats the nominal +4 dBm with all eight lines on. static: the S-curve of the model's static laws (other sources held at the start); stable = the heater power rises with the ring temperature (self-heating loop gain below 1); the middle branch cannot be held open loop. folds: where the stable branches end. p_ring_dbm: light reaching the ring on its line. monitor_code saturates at the ADC full scale.
